worldcombat.skill.worryseed.summary: Toss a worry seed: on a foe it temporarily turns the Ability into Insomnia and wakes it; on a sleeping ally it wakes them. While the seed lasts, sleep moves cannot put either back to sleep. Can be thrown at open ground, where it just scatters.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.use.0: Replace a foe's dangerous Ability with Insomnia
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.use.1: Wake a sleeping partner and shield it from the next sleep
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.use.2: Shut down sleep tactics by keeping the target awake
Throws the seed at a target or world point within %1$s blocks after a %2$s s wind-up, at about %3$s blocks/tick.

The seed lasts %1$s, waking the target and preventing sleep moves from putting it to sleep again. Ordinary creatures and players receive this protection too. A Pokémon with a replaceable Ability temporarily gains Insomnia; an unsuppressible or already-Insomnia target refuses and the seed scatters.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.deep.0: Deep planting: worry lasts ×1.7 and cooldown +20 ticks; one cast locks the target down.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.deep.1: Shallow planting: worry lasts ×0.6 and cooldown −12 ticks; cheap enough to re-seed often.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.growth.0: At level %1$s, base cooldown drops to %2$s; Speed and configuration still adjust the actual cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.growth.1: At level %1$s, base cooldown drops to %2$s; Speed and configuration still adjust the actual cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.preference.d: On = deep planting: worry ×1.7 and cooldown +20 ticks, one cast locks the target down. Off = shallow planting: worry ×0.6 and cooldown −12 ticks, cheap enough to re-seed often. Duration trades against how often you cast.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.preference.h: On, a sleeping or drowsy partner gets a seed that wakes it and blocks the coming sleep. Off, the companion only seeds foes and never spends a seed on an ally.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.preference.a: Only consider seeding a threat inside this distance; larger seeds earlier from farther away, smaller only at close range.
On, a holding companion will leave its post to seed a foe; off, it only casts when already in reach.
world_combat.move.worryseed.text.woken: Awake: sleep protection while the seed lasts
